title: 2026-10-28_Rhombus_Botnet_Investigation_67e
description: Investigate and respond to unusual traffic patterns and potential security incidents in the network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and potential security incidents. Your task is to investigate and respond to these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

To proceed, enter the passkey 'start'.
levels.local_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

To proceed, enter the passkey 'start'.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content:
Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.

**Question:** What is the name of the suspicious service that is beaconing to an external server?
levels.solution: Check the running services and look for any unusual or unauthorized services that might be communicating externally. The suspicious service is likely named 'bot-beacon'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the running services and look for any unusual or unauthorized services that might be communicating externally.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services that are not part of the standard system services and might be related to network communication.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-units --type=service' to list all running services and identify any suspicious ones.

levels.title: Identify Abnormal Network Traffic Service
levels.content:
Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic.

**Question:** What is the name of the service generating the abnormal network traffic?
levels.solution: Investigate the network connections and look for any services that are sending a high volume of traffic to an unexpected destination. The service generating abnormal network traffic is likely named 'bot-flood'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate the network connections and look for any services that are sending a high volume of traffic to an unexpected destination.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check the network connections using tools like netstat or ss to identify services sending traffic to unexpected destinations.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'netstat -tuln' to list all network connections and identify any suspicious services.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content:
Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot.

**Question:** What is the persistence mechanism used by the suspicious service?
levels.solution: Check the systemd services and timers to see how the suspicious service is being started automatically. The persistence mechanism is likely a systemd timer named 'bot-beacon.timer'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services and timers to see how the suspicious service is being started automatically.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for systemd timers that might be triggering the suspicious service to run periodically.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-timers' to list all systemd timers and identify any suspicious ones.
